extensionDescription.message: Dedicated-window command shell for tabs, windows, and groups.

commandLaunchBmxt.description: Label for the global keyboard shortcut that opens BMXt or focuses an existing window.

commandResetBmxt.description: Label for the global keyboard shortcut that resets BMXt to a fresh state and opens or focuses the window.

commandToggleBmxtFloat.message: Toggle BMXt float prompt on the current page
commandToggleBmxtFloat.description: Label for the global keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the in-page BMXt float prompt on the active tab.
